setlist_extra.title: This Could Be The Last Time

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I'm A King Bee** (1 review): This was the final King Bee, played only twice in over twenty-three years [7]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): The Eyes performance was particularly long, creative, and well played [9]
- **Standing On The Moon** (1 review): The epic Standing on the Moon is the reason the reviewer loves the song [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-31.sbd.chaser.tetzeli.fix-10930.34841.reflac.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 162 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: The board sounds warm, picks up sonic detail, and flows like a river; The boys sounded so crisp that night, despite being overshadowed by neighbors [15][16]
- **gd1994-03-31.110955.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd94-03-31.sbd.miller.14833.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 158 min; rated 2.57/5 by 14 [4]. Said about its sound: The novelty of hearing King Bee wore off quickly during the set; The sound of the Omni venue was bad for the first few numbers [5][9]
- **gd1994-03-31.sbd.chaser.10930.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 162 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Jerry's connection with the crowd was described as being at an all-time high [6]
- Jerry really touched the crowd during the performance of Standing On The Moon [7]
- Reviewers admitted to consuming too much liquid, which likely enhanced their enjoyment [10]
- Reviewer felt let down compared to the previous night's blowout performance [5]
- This show was below average, wedged between two good shows, including the next day [11]
- King Bee was considered much better than Walkin' Blues or the same thing [12]
- The show was better than the reviewer remembered, despite a forgettable first set [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-31.sbd.chaser.tetzeli.fix-10930.34841.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Chaser and Bill Tetzeli; source: Dsbd>cdr [1]
- **gd1994-03-31.110955.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB/17th Row) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > TCD-D3 > DAT(m); [2]. Also: Uploader lists the full setlist including the encore I Fought the Law [2]
- **gd94-03-31.sbd.miller.14833.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:SBD -> DatTransfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) ->Prodif Plus ->Samplitude v6.0 ->SHNEncore Is Missing (I Fought The Law)Transfered By Charlie Miller. [4]
- **gd1994-03-31.sbd.chaser.10930.shnf**: taped by chaser; source: Dsbd>cdr [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-04-01 The Omni, Atlanta, GA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-04-01-the-omni-atlanta-ga-usa/) [18]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Jerry at the Omni 1994](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/jerry-omni-1994) [19]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Jerry at the Omni 1994](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/jerry-omni-1994) [20]
